chunks: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) loves a servant, He turns people against him.
ai.seo_question: Why does God make people oppose those He loves?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the divine mechanism of testing beloved servants by inciting people to oppose or afflict them. It highlights that divine love may manifest through external trials and social friction as a means of purification or elevation.
